decisions.story_title: TranslatePress WordPress Plugin Unauthenticated Account Takeover Affects 400K+ Sites
decisions.reason: Unauthenticated account takeover in TranslatePress plugin (400K+ active installs). Attacker can obtain admin password reset link if target's profile language is set to a secondary language. Reported through Wordfence Bug Bounty. Note: mechanical clustering incorrectly placed this in the Kirki story; TranslatePress is a separate plugin.
Single VBS malware sample analysis in Korean targeting Japanese speakers. Isolated sample, no broader campaign or notable threat actor attribution.

decisions.story_title: Seoul National University Hospital Breach Affects 830K, Years of Undisclosed Cybersecurity Failures
decisions.reason: Hospital failed to file mandatory cybersecurity disclosures for years despite a breach affecting 830,000 people. Significant breach with regulatory compliance failure angle.

decisions.story_title: CERT-AGID Identifies Phishing Campaign Targeting Italy's INPS Social Security Agency
decisions.reason: Active phishing campaign impersonating INPS (Italy's social security agency) using fake 730 euro tax refund lure to steal personal data and payment card details. Identified by CERT-AGID.
